source: Protomaps basemap water polygons — the same file the chart draws (public/map/hudson.pmtiles)
note: nm[i] is the open water toward bearing i*stepDeg from the measuring point, stopped at the first land. The measuring point is the most open water within 0.35 nm of the berth: a ray from the bulkhead itself dies on the next pier. stations[id] is the same round of rays at each NOAA current station, rounded to a tenth of a mile.

depth.source: NOAA NCEI digital elevation mosaic (DEM_all), sampled along the same rays
depth.note: depthFt[k] is the mean depth of the water under the fetch toward k*45°, in feet. A modelled sea floor, used only inside the wave estimate — never shown, never for navigation. null where the rays that way hold no water to sample.
